results.title: Psychology says people who ace job interviews may share this one skill that has little to do with their resume
results.description: Performing well in an interview and performing well on the job require some of the same abilities, but success in one does not automatically predict success in the other. A highly capable employee may struggle to present themselves effectively when being evaluated, while a confident and polished candidate may give an excellent interview without necessarily becoming the strongest performer once hired.
